player_prompt.intro: Usesikhaleni esinezinkinobho {num_buttons}: {buttons}. Inkinobho ngayinye ihlotshaniswa nokusatshalaliswa kweBernoulli ngesilinganiso esibekiwe kodwa esingaziwa; izindlela zezinkinobho zingahluka. Ngenkinobho ngayinye, uma uyicindezela, uzothola umvuzo osuselwa ekwabelaneni okuhambisanayo. Unezinyathelo zesikhathi {num_turns} futhi, esinyathelweni ngasinye sesikhathi, ungakhetha noma iyiphi inkinobho bese uthola umvuzo. Umgomo wakho ukukhetha ngokuhlelekile izinkinobho esinyathelweni ngasinye sesikhathi ukuqoqa imininingwane mayelana nokusatshalaliswa komvuzo wazo, okuzokuvumela ukuthi ukhethe inkinobho enenani eliphakeme kakhulu lomvuzo ngokufanele ekupheleni kwemijikelezo {num_turns}.

game_action.pressed: Ucindezele inkinobho {button} futhi wathola umvuzo ka {reward}.

game_message.final_decision: Njengoba usuyisebenzise yonke imali yakho ukuze uzame izindlela ezihlukahlukene futhi ubone ukuthi ziyanelisa yini, manje yenza isinqumo sokuthi iyiphi indlela engcono kakhulu.
